content: {"like":["Values vibrant, cheeky, and inclusive storytelling with strong visual style and music;","Prefers period pieces with incredible costumes and deco architecture over more traditional classics;","Enjoys brilliant casting and a tone that balances humor with compassion;","Finds personal connection when content resonates with family, especially grandchildren;","Appreciates shows that stand out from typical TV fare, favoring Miss Fisher over Downton Abbey."],"dislike":["Dislikes content that feels old-fashioned, dated, or of unpleasant quality;","Avoids shows or movies that are darker or overly grim compared to lighter counterparts;","Rejects material that fails to live up to its source or is considered overrated;","Steers clear of content with ethnic stereotypes or racism;","Prefers not to revisit or rewatch shows that are not classics or that he wouldn't buy again."]}
